name: Fancy Frontier
blurb: Taiwan's largest doujinshi convention, held twice a year (February and August) at Taipei Expo Park, with circle sales, cosplay and model kits.
notes: FF47 ran 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-23 (per EventGo listing and site history), already over as of the 2026-10-05 check date. FF48, the next numbered Fancy Frontier edition (normally February), has no announced dates yet on the official site's news feed or nav as of this check; nothing confirmed to list in the 2026-10-05..2027-12-31 window. The homepage currently promotes two same-organizer sister events that are NOT the main FF brand and are left out of this file: 'Petit Fancy 45 x Reality Fantasy 14' (2026-11-07/08, Taipei Expo Park Flower Expo Hall) and the Kaohsiung-only '2026 駁二動漫祭' / FFK19 (2026-12-05/06, Pier-2 Art Center, Kaohsiung) — both are separate, smaller doujin events under the same company, distinct from the Feb/Aug Taipei 'FF' series the seed note describes. 2026-10-05 fixup pass: homepage re-checked fresh, still no FF48 date; recorded FF47 as "last".
